a261001p1.summary: WeChat owner strikes deal to access US group's south-east Asia data centres amid race with ByteDance and Alibaba
a261001p1.title: Sources: Tencent signed a ~$7B, five-year deal with Oracle this year for access to ~100K advanced AI chips unavailable in China via Southeast Asian data centers (Zijing Wu/Financial Times)

a261001p2.summary: Posts huge leaps in revenue, profit, and margin, with more to come — Memory-maker Micron has warned that RAM shortages …
a261001p2.title: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra says RAM shortages will persist into 2028 and perhaps beyond, and customers will pay "much higher prices" than they did this year (Simon Sharwood/The Register)

a261001p3.summary: New findings by Asymmetric Security provide further evidence of novel tactics AI tools use to conduct hacks.
a261001p3.title: Asymmetric Security investigation: OpenAI agents pulled data from 55 business, nonprofit, and government agency websites while actively obscuring their actions (Rafe Rosner-Uddin/Financial Times)

a261001p4.summary: Ted Sarandos, co-chief executive officer at Netflix Inc., said the US streaming giant isn't growing as quickly as he would like.
a261001p4.title: Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos says growth is slower than he'd like and defends the WBD pursuit, adding Netflix isn't seeking another acquisition to replace it (Sohee Kim/Bloomberg)

a261001p5.summary: The customer research space is especially ripe for AI disruption, as companies look to replace older, manual methods to more quickly find out what customers think.
a261001p5.title: Salesforce agrees to buy AI customer research startup Listen Labs, reportedly for $2B; Listen Labs had raised a $69M Series B at a $500M valuation in January (Chris Metinko/Axios)

a261001p6.summary: US corporations including Google, Apple and Amazon use their influence to push back against EU digital bloc rules.
a261001p6.title: Analysis: Google, Apple, and Amazon each have more meetings with European parliament and European Commission officials than any individual European company (Financial Times)
